sections.title: Overview

ATM10 includes it as a general mod.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Accelerated Decay" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: allthewizardgear-1.21.1-1.1.12.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "All the Wizard Gear" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.name: Ars Ocultas
mods.summary: Magic progression, spells, rituals, artifacts, or supernatural resources.
mods.author: mystchonky
mods.complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.

sections.title: Overview
items: Magic progression, spells, rituals, artifacts, or supernatural resources.
ATM10 includes it as a magic mod.
Installed file: ars_ocultas-1.21.1-2.4.1.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Craft or find the mod's guide book if it has one, then unlock the first crafting station or ritual block.
Learn the resource loop first: mana/source/aureal/essence generation, storage, and transfer.
Make a low-risk spell, ritual, or artifact setup before using it near important builds.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Magic.
Complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Ars Ocultas" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.author: IchHabeHunger54
mods.complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: bibliowoods-1.21.1-1.6.2.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Bibliowoods Legacy" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: crashutilities-9.0.4.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Crash Utilities" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Machines, power, automation, transport, or processing systems.
ATM10 includes it as a tech mod.
Installed file: create-1.21.1-6.0.10.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Start with water wheels or windmills, shafts, gearboxes, belts, depots, and mechanical presses.
Use ponder/tutorial views in-game whenever available; they are the fastest way to understand contraptions.
Build compact lines for crushing, washing, pressing, mixing, and deploying before building large factories.
Watch stress units and rotation direction; gearboxes, clutches, and speed controllers solve most routing issues.
Use trains, contraptions, and Create add-ons after core processing is reliable.

sections.title: Overview
items: Machines, power, automation, transport, or processing systems.
ATM10 includes it as a tech mod.
Installed file: createaddition-1.5.10.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Identify the mod's power system, machine casing/frame, first generator, and basic cable/pipe block.
Build a one-machine test line with input storage, output storage, power, and a visible recipe from JEI/EMI.
Only expand after you understand side configuration, upgrades, and whether the machine accepts items, fluids, gases, or energy.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Tech.
Complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Create Crafts & Additions" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.name: Deimos Lib
mods.summary: A support library or API used by other mods in the pack.
mods.author: Mars
mods.complexity: Low: dependency mod, usually no direct player progression.

sections.title: Overview
items: A support library or API used by other mods in the pack.
ATM10 includes it as a library / dependency mod.
Installed file: deimos-1.21.1-neoforge-2.6.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: This mod is mainly present because another mod depends on it.
Do not remove it from the pack; missing libraries usually prevent Minecraft from launching.
Use its source/project page when troubleshooting crashes that mention its mod id.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Library / Dependency.
Complexity: Low: dependency mod, usually no direct player progression.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Deimos Lib" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.summary: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
mods.author: Buuz135
mods.complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: dysoncubeproject-1.0.5.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Dyson Cube Project" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview

ATM10 includes it as a storage mod.
Installed file: EnderStorage-1.21.1-2.13.0.191.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Start with a small inventory setup, then add filtering, upgrades, and external access.
Route common bulk items separately from rare gear so filters and void upgrades are safer.
Connect to AE2 or another main storage network only after insert/extract rules are tested.

Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.

items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: EuphoriaPatcher-1.8.6-r5.7.1-neoforge.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.

mods.author: BlayTheNinth

sections.title: Overview
items: Resource generation, farming, crops, bees, ore processing, or passive production.
ATM10 includes it as a farming & resources mod.
Installed file: farmingforblockheads-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.13.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Find the first seed, hive, pot, machine, or resource block and confirm its growth/production condition.
Automate harvesting and output collection before adding many resource types.
Buffer outputs in drawers or AE2 to avoid item overflow on a server.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: hardenedarmadillos-1.21.1-0.2.0.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Hardened Armadillos" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: Iceberg-1.21.1-neoforge-1.3.2.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Iceberg [Neo/Forge]" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.name: In Control!
mods.summary: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
mods.author: McJty
mods.complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: incontrol-1.21-10.2.6.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "In Control!" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Machines, power, automation, transport, or processing systems.
ATM10 includes it as a tech mod.
Installed file: industrialforegoing-1.21-3.6.38.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Start with latex production, dissolution chamber recipes, and basic machine frames.
Use plant gatherers/sowers, mob machines, and fluid handling as your first practical automation.
Add range upgrades carefully so farms do not create lag or harvest unintended areas.
Route outputs through drawers, AE2, or other bulk storage before scaling farms.
Use JEI/EMI for machine additives and special recipes; many machines have non-obvious fluid inputs.

sections.title: Overview
items: Blocks, textures, furniture, lights, or building-focused variants.
ATM10 includes it as a building & decoration mod.
Installed file: mcw-doors-1.1.5-mc1.21.1neoforge.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod in JEI/EMI and preview block families, variants, and crafting stations.
Build a small palette wall before committing resources to a large structure.
Use connected-texture, copy, chisel, or variant tools carefully around machines and storage blocks.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Building & Decoration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Macaw's Doors" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod in JEI/EMI and preview block families, variants, and crafting stations.
Build a small palette wall before committing resources to a large structure.
Use connected-texture, copy, chisel, or variant tools carefully around machines and storage blocks.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.

sections.title: Important parts

Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Blocks, textures, furniture, lights, or building-focused variants.
ATM10 includes it as a building & decoration mod.
Installed file: mcw-holidays-1.1.2-mc1.21.1neoforge.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod in JEI/EMI and preview block families, variants, and crafting stations.
Build a small palette wall before committing resources to a large structure.
Use connected-texture, copy, chisel, or variant tools carefully around machines and storage blocks.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Building & Decoration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Macaw's Holidays" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Blocks, textures, furniture, lights, or building-focused variants.
ATM10 includes it as a building & decoration mod.
Installed file: mcw-mcwpaths-1.1.1-mc1.21.1neoforge.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod in JEI/EMI and preview block families, variants, and crafting stations.
Build a small palette wall before committing resources to a large structure.
Use connected-texture, copy, chisel, or variant tools carefully around machines and storage blocks.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Building & Decoration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Macaw's Paths and Pavings" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Blocks, textures, furniture, lights, or building-focused variants.
ATM10 includes it as a building & decoration mod.
Installed file: mcw-roofs-2.3.2-mc1.21.1neoforge.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod in JEI/EMI and preview block families, variants, and crafting stations.
Build a small palette wall before committing resources to a large structure.
Use connected-texture, copy, chisel, or variant tools carefully around machines and storage blocks.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Building & Decoration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Macaw's Roofs" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Blocks, textures, furniture, lights, or building-focused variants.
ATM10 includes it as a building & decoration mod.
Installed file: mcw-mcwstairs-1.0.2-mc1.21.1neoforge.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod in JEI/EMI and preview block families, variants, and crafting stations.
Build a small palette wall before committing resources to a large structure.
Use connected-texture, copy, chisel, or variant tools carefully around machines and storage blocks.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Building & Decoration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Macaw's Stairs" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Blocks, textures, furniture, lights, or building-focused variants.
ATM10 includes it as a building & decoration mod.
Installed file: mcw-trapdoors-1.1.5-mc1.21.1neoforge.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod in JEI/EMI and preview block families, variants, and crafting stations.
Build a small palette wall before committing resources to a large structure.
Use connected-texture, copy, chisel, or variant tools carefully around machines and storage blocks.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Building & Decoration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Macaw's Trapdoors" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: mahoutsukai-1.21.1-v1.36.26.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Mahou Tsukai" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

Do not remove it from the pack; missing libraries usually prevent Minecraft from launching.
Use its source/project page when troubleshooting crashes that mention its mod id.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Overview
items: Machines, power, automation, transport, or processing systems.
ATM10 includes it as a tech mod.
Installed file: Mekanism-1.21.1-10.7.19.85.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Begin with basic generators, metallurgic infusers, enrichment chambers, and universal cables.
Upgrade ore processing in stages: enrichment, purification, injection, crystallization, and dissolution lines.
Use gas pipes and chemical tanks deliberately; most Mekanism problems are missing gases, wrong side configs, or no power.
Move into digital miner, induction matrix, fission, and fusion once stable power and waste handling are solved.
For reactors, build containment and test the full fuel and coolant chain before running at high burn rates.

sections.title: Tutorial

ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: Modern-Dynamics-0.9.6.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Modern Dynamics" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Machines, power, automation, transport, or processing systems.
ATM10 includes it as a tech mod.
Installed file: Modern-Industrialization-2.4.3.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Identify the mod's power system, machine casing/frame, first generator, and basic cable/pipe block.
Build a one-machine test line with input storage, output storage, power, and a visible recipe from JEI/EMI.
Only expand after you understand side configuration, upgrades, and whether the machine accepts items, fluids, gases, or energy.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a performance & rendering mod.
Installed file: modernfix-neoforge-5.27.7+mc1.21.1.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Start from the default ATM10 profile and change one visual/performance option at a time.
Keep a known-good shader and video settings profile before experimenting.
If crashes or visual bugs appear, disable shaders first, then test performance mods one by one.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Performance & Rendering.
Complexity: Low to medium: configure it once, then adjust as needed.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "ModernFix" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.name: Occultism KubeJS
mods.summary: Magic progression, spells, rituals, artifacts, or supernatural resources.
mods.author: kli_kli
mods.complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.

sections.title: Overview
items: Magic progression, spells, rituals, artifacts, or supernatural resources.
ATM10 includes it as a magic mod.
Installed file: occultism_kubejs-1.21.1-neoforge-1.11.0.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Craft or find the mod's guide book if it has one, then unlock the first crafting station or ritual block.
Learn the resource loop first: mana/source/aureal/essence generation, storage, and transfer.
Make a low-risk spell, ritual, or artifact setup before using it near important builds.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Magic.
Complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Occultism KubeJS" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: Oh-The-Trees-Youll-Grow-neoforge-1.21.1-5.3.1.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Oh The Trees You'll Grow" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: OpenLoader-neoforge-1.21.1-21.1.5.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Open Loader" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Resource generation, farming, crops, bees, ore processing, or passive production.
ATM10 includes it as a farming & resources mod.
Installed file: pamhc2foodcore-NEOFORGE-1.21.1-1.0.4.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Find the first seed, hive, pot, machine, or resource block and confirm its growth/production condition.
Automate harvesting and output collection before adding many resource types.
Buffer outputs in drawers or AE2 to avoid item overflow on a server.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Farming & Resources.
Complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Pam's HarvestCraft 2 - Food Core" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: pamhc2trees-NEOFORGE-1.21.1-1.0.9.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Pam's HarvestCraft 2 - Trees" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

Do not remove it from the pack; missing libraries usually prevent Minecraft from launching.
Use its source/project page when troubleshooting crashes that mention its mod id.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Library / Dependency.
Complexity: Low: dependency mod, usually no direct player progression.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "PolyLib" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

Installed file: productivebees-1.21.1-13.13.5.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Start with vanilla bees, nests, treats, cages, and basic hives.
Use JEI/EMI to check each bee's breeding or conversion method and its required flower/block.
Build simulation upgrades, bottlers, centrifuges, and gene tools once basic production works.
Keep bees organized by resource tier and automate comb processing before expanding to rare bees.
Use the official wiki for mutation details because individual bee requirements change between versions.

mods.name: Productive Metalworks
mods.summary: Resource generation, farming, crops, bees, ore processing, or passive production.
mods.author: LobsterJonn
mods.complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.

sections.title: Overview
items: Resource generation, farming, crops, bees, ore processing, or passive production.
ATM10 includes it as a farming & resources mod.
Installed file: productivemetalworks-1.21.1-1.15.0.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Find the first seed, hive, pot, machine, or resource block and confirm its growth/production condition.
Automate harvesting and output collection before adding many resource types.
Buffer outputs in drawers or AE2 to avoid item overflow on a server.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Farming & Resources.
Complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Productive Metalworks" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.name: Productive Trees
mods.summary: Resource generation, farming, crops, bees, ore processing, or passive production.
mods.author: LobsterJonn
mods.complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.

sections.title: Overview
items: Resource generation, farming, crops, bees, ore processing, or passive production.
ATM10 includes it as a farming & resources mod.
Installed file: productivetrees-1.21.1-0.8.1.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Find the first seed, hive, pot, machine, or resource block and confirm its growth/production condition.
Automate harvesting and output collection before adding many resource types.
Buffer outputs in drawers or AE2 to avoid item overflow on a server.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Farming & Resources.
Complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Productive Trees" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: Rainbows-1.21-1.5.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Rainbows!" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: Blocks, textures, furniture, lights, or building-focused variants.
ATM10 includes it as a building & decoration mod.
Installed file: rechiseled_chipped-2.0-1.21.1.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod in JEI/EMI and preview block families, variants, and crafting stations.
Build a small palette wall before committing resources to a large structure.
Use connected-texture, copy, chisel, or variant tools carefully around machines and storage blocks.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Building & Decoration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Rechiseled: Chipped" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.summary: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
mods.author: botanydev
mods.complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: Structory_26.1_v1.3.16.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Structory" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Sushi Go Crafting" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: World generation, structures, mobs, dimensions, bosses, or exploration content.
ATM10 includes it as a world & exploration mod.
Installed file: the_bumblezone-7.13.2+1.21.1-neoforge.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Read any progression requirements before entering new structures, dimensions, or boss arenas.
Bring waypoint tools, spare food, recovery gear, blocks, and an escape method.
Check loot, mob drops, and boss rewards in JEI/EMI to decide when the content is worth tackling.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: World & Exploration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "The Bumblezone (NeoForge/Forge)" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Overview
items: World generation, structures, mobs, dimensions, bosses, or exploration content.
ATM10 includes it as a world & exploration mod.
Installed file: The_Undergarden-1.21.1-0.9.6.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Read any progression requirements before entering new structures, dimensions, or boss arenas.
Bring waypoint tools, spare food, recovery gear, blocks, and an escape method.
Check loot, mob drops, and boss rewards in JEI/EMI to decide when the content is worth tackling.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: World & Exploration.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "The Undergarden" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.name: Theurgy
mods.summary: Magic progression, spells, rituals, artifacts, or supernatural resources.
mods.author: kli_kli
mods.complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.

sections.title: Overview
items: Magic progression, spells, rituals, artifacts, or supernatural resources.
ATM10 includes it as a magic mod.
Installed file: theurgy-1.21.1-neoforge-1.73.1.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Craft or find the mod's guide book if it has one, then unlock the first crafting station or ritual block.
Learn the resource loop first: mana/source/aureal/essence generation, storage, and transfer.
Make a low-risk spell, ritual, or artifact setup before using it near important builds.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Magic.
Complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "Theurgy" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

mods.name: XyCraft
mods.summary: Resource generation, farming, crops, bees, ore processing, or passive production.
mods.author: Soaryn
mods.complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.

sections.title: Overview
items: Resource generation, farming, crops, bees, ore processing, or passive production.
ATM10 includes it as a farming & resources mod.
Installed file: xycraft_core-0.7.53-all.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Find the first seed, hive, pot, machine, or resource block and confirm its growth/production condition.
Automate harvesting and output collection before adding many resource types.
Buffer outputs in drawers or AE2 to avoid item overflow on a server.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: Farming & Resources.
Complexity: Medium to high: best learned through staged progression and JEI/EMI recipes.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "XyCraft" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Identify the mod's power system, machine casing/frame, first generator, and basic cable/pipe block.
Build a one-machine test line with input storage, output storage, power, and a visible recipe from JEI/EMI.
Only expand after you understand side configuration, upgrades, and whether the machine accepts items, fluids, gases, or energy.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Overview
items: A gameplay, utility, content, or compatibility mod included in ATM10.
ATM10 includes it as a general mod.
Installed file: xycraft_override-0.7.53.jar.

sections.title: Tutorial
items: Search the mod's item list and recipes in JEI/EMI.
Look for an in-game guide book, advancements, quest entries, or config screen.
Try a small sample of its blocks/items, then follow the official docs for deeper progression.
Open JEI/EMI and search the mod name to see its blocks, items, and recipes in this pack.
Check the official project page, wiki, or source links in the Sources section before assuming older tutorials still match ATM10.
Test one small setup in creative or a safe base area before scaling it on a shared server.

sections.title: Important parts
items: Main role: General.
Complexity: Medium: check recipes, config, and official docs before scaling it in a shared world.
Best first tool: JEI/EMI search for "XyCraft: Override" plus any guide book or wiki linked below.
For shared servers, test chunk loading, automation loops, and high-volume farms before leaving them unattended.

sections.title: ATM10 notes
items: ATM10 can change recipes and progression through pack scripts, so JEI/EMI inside the pack is the final authority for crafting.
Quest book entries, advancements, and in-game manuals should be checked before following old videos.
When a mod has no direct player-facing content, keep it installed because another mod may require it.
